mcqs.question: Which of the following metals reacts most vigorously with cold water at room temperature?
mcqs.explanation: Sodium belongs to the group of alkali metals that react explosively with cold water, producing sodium hydroxide and hydrogen gas. Magnesium reacts only with hot water, while iron and copper show little or no reaction with cold water.

mcqs.question: Which metal does NOT react with dilute hydrochloric acid to produce hydrogen gas?
mcqs.explanation: Copper is placed below hydrogen in the reactivity series, so it cannot displace hydrogen from acids. Zinc, iron, and magnesium are above hydrogen and therefore react with dilute HCl, releasing hydrogen gas.

mcqs.question: What best describes the process of hydrogen displacement when a metal reacts with an acid?

options.A: The metal dissolves without any gas evolution.
options.B: The metal replaces hydrogen in the acid, forming a salt and releasing hydrogen gas.
options.C: Hydrogen replaces the metal, forming a metal hydride.
options.D: The acid is reduced to water.

mcqs.answer: The metal replaces hydrogen in the acid, forming a salt and releasing hydrogen gas.
mcqs.explanation: Hydrogen displacement occurs when a metal higher than hydrogen in the reactivity series reacts with an acid, producing a salt of the metal and liberating hydrogen gas. Options A, C, and D describe unrelated processes.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: According to the reactivity series, which metal can be used to obtain copper metal from an aqueous solution of copper sulfate?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is placed above copper in the reactivity series, so it can displace copper ions from CuSO₄ solution, depositing copper metal and forming ZnSO₄. Silver, gold, and lead are below copper and cannot displace it.

mcqs.question: Which metal reacts with hot water but does not react with cold water?
mcqs.explanation: Magnesium reacts slowly with cold water but reacts more readily with hot water, producing magnesium hydroxide and hydrogen gas. Sodium reacts with cold water, while iron and copper show negligible reaction even with hot water.

mcqs.question: Metal X when added to dilute H₂SO₄ produces bubbles of gas, while metal Y shows no visible reaction. Which pair correctly identifies X and Y?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc, being above hydrogen in the reactivity series, reacts with dilute sulfuric acid to release hydrogen gas. Copper, placed below hydrogen, does not react. The other options either pair a non‑reactive metal as X or a reactive metal as Y, contradicting observed behavior.

mcqs.question: All metals, when added to acids, evolve hydrogen gas. Is this statement true or false?
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. Only metals that are higher than hydrogen in the reactivity series (e.g., Zn, Fe, Mg) can displace hydrogen from acids. Metals like copper, silver, and gold, which are below hydrogen, do not evolve hydrogen gas when mixed with acids.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: Given the reactivity series, which metal will NOT displace lead from a solution of lead nitrate?
mcqs.explanation: Copper lies below lead in the reactivity series, so it cannot displace lead ions from lead nitrate solution. Iron, zinc, and aluminum are above lead and can successfully displace lead ions, forming their respective nitrates and depositing lead metal.
